name: gameye
description: Teach your coding agent to ship multiplayer: skills for authoritative server design, engine server builds, containerization, the Gameye sessions API, matchmaking and launch, plus the bundled Gameye MCP server.

gameye_api_token.title: Gameye API token
gameye_api_token.description: API token from the Gameye Admin Panel (Users > API Tokens) for the environment below. Use the narrowest scopes you need. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.

gameye_env.title: Gameye environment
gameye_env.description: sandbox (self-serve customers; their permanent home, live matches run there) or production (enterprise customers onboarded by Gameye). Tokens from one environment do not work on the other.
